title: paeonia officinalis f. leiocarpa
intro: Paeonia officinalis f. leiocarpa, commonly known as Garden Peony, is a species of flowering plant in the family Paeoniaceae. This perennial plant is known for its beautiful flowers and has been used in traditional medicine for centuries, particularly for its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties. The health benefits of Paeonia officinalis f. leiocarpa include its ability to reduce anxiety and stress, alleviate menstrual cramps, and improve sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and glycosides, that exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
